note: Semantic-judge baseline of the LLM behavior eval.  Generated from a clean run with --judge llm (0 execution errors, 0 judge degradations) once the judge provider was stable.  Semantic metrics (groundedness, hallucination_rate, summary_faithfulness, summary_completeness) measure what substring matching cannot; this file is the REFERENCE baseline for manual analysis, NOT the CI gate baseline (see llm-eval-baseline.json, which the CI gates on via --judge deterministic).

known_anomaly.ans-006: judge flagged grounded=False but its own ungrounded_claims note says the core concept is consistent with context and the answer fabricates nothing — the judge over-applied the 'covered_facts must be verbatim from the list' instruction to a faithful paraphrase.  Semantic judge noise, not a real grounding defect.
